messages:
emma_partnerships: Halo Integrator confirmed a joint webinar + live studio demo on Aug 3. Need speakers, demo failover plan, swag (power banks + stickers), and marketplace banner timing.
leo_hw: We'll demo hardware-accelerated int8 ops. Partner prefers running from their studio rack; Redwood provides cloud fallback.
priya_pm: Speaker slate: Priya (host), Olga (Halo lead), Leo (hardware demo), Casey (customer cameo). Olga, can you confirm Casey?
olga_halo: Casey confirmed. We'll send a 60s partner intro video and logo assets by Mon.
nate_eng: For fallback I'll spin up a Dedicated pool and add health endpoint /healthz returning 200. Use header X-Demo: halo for routing.
isle_ops: Swag: Redwood ships 200 power banks to Halo HQ and 50 to SF office. Need customs contact for EU shipments.
tom_marketing: Landing page + UTM: I can build LP. Need promo code and short copy (2 lines) + 3 field form. Who owns promo?
emma_partnerships: Halo to provide promo code. Also ask for one co-branded hero image. Decks due Jul 20.
olga_halo: Promo code HALO15 confirmed. We'll DM logos and hero by Mon.
nate_eng: Quick SSH helper for studio NAT: ssh -i demo_key ubuntu@proxy.redwood.com -L 8080:localhost:8080. I'll upload key to secure share.
isle_ops: Shipping timeline: power banks US ship Jul 10, EU Jul 17. Please cc logistics@redwood on addresses by Jul 1.
calendar-bot: Rehearsal created  Jul 29 09:00 PDT, duration 75m. Invitees: emma_partnerships, leo_hw, priya_pm, nate_eng, olga_halo, casey_customer.
tom_marketing: I'll draft post-webinar email and a swag raffle mechanic. Need attendee CSV export owner.
emma_partnerships: Action items: 1) Logos + hero by Jun 30, 2) Decks by Jul 20, 3) Health endpoint + SSH by Jul 15, 4) Swag addresses by Jul 1. Anything else?
leo_hw: Add an alert to #eng-oncall if p95 > 200ms during rehearsal.
nate_eng: Will do. Thanks everyone :rocket:
